units.function: names what the paper did not settle

original_instantiations: What sets that parameter, and how big is each push? We wanted to know and did not get there.
What sets that parameter, and how large is each push? We wanted to know and did not get there.

units.source_excerpt: What factors influence the selection of this parameter? How to measure the sizes of these impacts? We are interested in these questions but fail to investigate them
units.reusable_pattern: End on the questions left open, and admit the failure to chase them.
prohibited_generalizations: do not imply the questions were answered

units.function: closes the paper with the works cited

original_instantiations: The works drawn on are set out one by one.
The works drawn on are set down one by one.

units.source_excerpt: References
units.reusable_pattern: Close with a numbered list of the works used.
prohibited_generalizations: do not treat the list as an argument
